req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint must: (1) return HTTP 200 with the updated task body on valid input, (2) return HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist, (3) support partial updates (only provided fields change), (4) enforce field constraints such as title min_length=1 and max_length=100. Tests cover EP (normal update), NEG (missing task, invalid body), BVA (title at length boundaries 1 and 100 chars), STC (completed flag toggled false->true->false), and DT (partial vs full update combinations). Each test creates its own task via POST to remain self-contained and idempotent against an empty database.

tests.name: test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_body
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ before the PUT call
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Original', description='Old desc', completed=false
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with title='Updated', description='New desc', completed=true
expected: Response body id matches created task id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_body():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Original", "description": "Old desc", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "Updated", "description": "New desc", "completed": True})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == task_id
    assert body["title"] == "Updated"
    assert body["description"] == "New desc"
    assert body["completed"] is True
